sections.Profile:
Sky Divers, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in April 1964, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine themed around skydiving. Designed by Ted Zale, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, three mushroom bumpers, and three slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Sky Diving, Parachutes, Sports, Original Theme
